The @pressfreedom (CJP) reports a record 129 #journalists and media workers were killed in 2025, the deadliest year since data collection began three decades ago.
The report attributes two-thirds of these deaths to Israeli fire, primarily involving Palestinian reporters in Gaza.
While the Israeli military denies targeting journalists and cites their involvement in terror activities, the CPJ highlights a growing culture of global impunity.
Fatalities also increased in Ukraine and Sudan due to rising drone use, alongside ongoing unsolved killings of reporters in Mexico, the Philippines, and Bangladesh.
